body:
Worker rule (Termal::BarA1, 2026-11-27 03:25Z; my own slip on w-270432962caf candidate a9d9d282, corrected by Opus2 #86).
A dispatch that says "run the review pair EARLY" does NOT authorize spawning it. Review pairs run through the Central pair slot, one pair at a time, and start only on Opus2's named SPAWN NOW for that exact commit. When the candidate may still change (for example a new regression test that could fail and pull in a product fix), wait for the focused result first, since a failure changes the reviewed input. I spawned Codex and Claude reviewers right after READY-FOCUSED and had to cancel both about a minute later. After READY-FOCUSED, end the turn and wait.
